purpose: Retain the single Pisco cap preparation inputs for the accepted job.

nozzle.reason: Match the installed abrasive-compatible fixed left hotend and the approved cap recipe.

wall_loops.reason: The rear-equipment-caps recipe: three Classic loops and solid infill keep the complete spring section.

sparse_infill_density.reason: The rear-equipment-caps recipe: solid stock through the cap body, leaves, roots and hooks.

sparse_infill_pattern.reason: The rear-equipment-caps recipe: solid cap deposition.

overhang_1_4_speed.reason: Walls at their own speed through the slicer's two shallowest overhang points, as the faucet plate Derek accepted laid its base and tip (tools/hsm/print-prep/faucet-plate.json, shallow_overhang_wall_speed); the steeper points, bridges and their fan keep the filament's.

overhang_2_4_speed.reason: Walls at their own speed through the slicer's two shallowest overhang points, as the faucet plate Derek accepted laid its base and tip (tools/hsm/print-prep/faucet-plate.json, shallow_overhang_wall_speed); the steeper points, bridges and their fan keep the filament's.

recipe.pose_reason: The Pisco cap stands on its exported axial end so its springs bend within the layers; the native smooth-timelapse tower provides time away between cap layers.

wall_loops.reason: The approved production wall count retains the cap spring section.

sparse_infill_density.reason: Solid stock through the cap bodies, leaves, roots and hooks.

timelapse_type.reason: Smooth timelapse parks away and uses the native tower before returning to the cap.

enable_prime_tower.reason: Reprime on the native tower after each timelapse departure.

prime_tower_width.reason: A constant perimeter provides time away on every cap layer.

prime_tower_max_speed.reason: Time on the tower cools the cap while retaining the model print recipe.

wipe_tower_x.reason: Center the tower footprint within the seasoned bed region.

wipe_tower_y.reason: Separate the tower brim from the cap brim.

prime_tower_rib_wall.reason: Keep the requested tower width in single-colour smooth-timelapse mode.

overhang_2_4_speed.reason: The process holds the filament's speed at this point for the left Standard slot, so turning the filament's override off moves no part's speed here.

overhang_3_4_speed.reason: The process holds the filament's speed at this point for the left Standard slot, so turning the filament's override off moves no part's speed here.

override_process_overhang_speed.reason: The filament's overhang speeds stop overriding the process's, so each part's own two shallowest overhang points apply.

enable_support.reason: The Pisco cap prints without support in its production pose (rear-equipment-caps/README.md).

plate_offset_mm.reason: Center the combined cap and tower envelope with separate brim footprints.
